messages.author: Hrishikesh Dhondge
messages.body:
Hello,
I tried to install the AMBER as per the instructions in the manual. But
facing some problems in "make install" command.
While Linking C executable xaLeap, it gives error.
The error is as follows:
/usr/bin/ld: ../Xraw/libXaw.a(AsciiSrc.c.o): in function `InitStringOrFile':
AsciiSrc.c:(.text+0x145c): warning: the use of `tmpnam' is dangerous,
better use `mkstemp'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libSM.so: undefined reference to
`uuid_unparse_lower.UUID_1.0'
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libSM.so: undefined reference to
`uuid_generate.UUID_1.0'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make[2]: ***
[AmberTools/src/leap/src/leap/CMakeFiles/xaLeap.dir/build.make:248:
AmberTools/src/leap/src/leap/xaLeap] Error 1
make[1]: *** [CMakeFiles/Makefile2:8898:
AmberTools/src/leap/src/leap/CMakeFiles/xaLeap.dir/all] Error 2
make: *** [Makefile:152: all] Error 2
I looked for solution but did not found anything. What could be wrong?
Thanks in advance!
-- 
With regards
Hrishikesh Dhondge

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, May 15, 2020, Hrishikesh Dhondge wrote:
>
>I tried to install the AMBER as per the instructions in the manual. But
>facing some problems in "make install" command.
>
>While Linking C executable xaLeap, it gives error.
>The error is as follows:
>
>/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libSM.so: undefined reference to
>`uuid_unparse_lower.UUID_1.0'
>/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libSM.so: undefined reference to
>`uuid_generate.UUID_1.0'
>collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
What version of Linux are you using? Did you load all the libraries as
specified at ambermd.org/Installation.php?
As a workaround, you can add -DBUILD_GUI=FALSE to your run_cmake script,
which will skip building the X-related programs.
....dac

messages.author: Hrishikesh Dhondge
messages.body:
I am using Linux 19.10
But when I tried installation using sudo it gives me the mentioned error.
Then, I tried using superuser and it worked fine.
Thanks!
